prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions continue to underpredict gains on winning tests while remaining overoptimistic for non-winning tests.
Sign-in hint (6 wins across 15 tests), home wait_info (4 wins across 11 tests), adoption new_flow (3 wins across 5 tests), and finish new_flow (2 wins across 9 tests) were helpful.
Sign-in reorder changes consistently reduced performance across 2 tests.
Choose_path redesign changes consistently failed to improve performance across 4 tests.
Choose_path copy, home redesign, home new_screen, and adoption incentive changes showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Evidence remains thin for change types tested only once (e.g., finish copy, finish layout, finish redesign, home new_flow).

Changes:
0: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Existing Account Companion Restore Hint: Display a hint on the sign-in screen reassuring users that signing in will automatically bring back their previously saved desktop pets and settings. (why: Support received 8 emails about pets missing or resetting after signing in again, making account recovery reassurance a top priority.)
1: [adoption, new_flow] Interactive Companion Trait Calibration Flow: Insert an interactive trait calibration sub-flow before certificate signing where users fine-tune their pet's default personality and behavior parameters. (why: Adoption has a steep drop-off (71.9%) and support received complaints about custom pets failing or looking wrong. A calibration flow sets better expectations.)
2: [home, wait_info] Desktop Pet Hatching Stage Live Progress Log: Enable time estimates and step progress displays on the waiting screen while desktop pet asset generation completes in the background. (why: The waiting step has a long median duration of 201s. Showing clear wait information has proven effective in past home tests.)
3: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Companion Interaction Gesture Guide Flow: Add an interactive gesture tutorial screen right before finishing onboarding to walk users through dragging, summoning, and hiding their desktop companion. (why: Support logged multiple tickets from users confused about how to control, hide, or talk to the pet post-setup.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Account Pet Data Cloud Recovery Hint: Add explicit cloud safety copy under sign-in options confirming that pet data is backed up safely across logins. (why: Sign-in hints have a high historical win rate (6/15) and address the 8 support emails concerning lost pet data upon re-login.)
5: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Pet Quick Action Menu Screen: Introduce a dedicated screen in the finish sequence demonstrating the system tray quick action menu for hiding and managing the desktop pet. (why: Users frequently report post-onboarding confusion regarding how to minimize or talk to the pet once setup concludes.)
6: [home, notification] Desktop Hatch Ready System Tray Alert Switch: Enable desktop notification toggles on the waiting screen so users get alerted immediately when pet rendering finishes. (why: The waiting step has a mean duration over 38 minutes (2336s), indicating users step away while pet generation finishes.)
7: [adoption, layout] Pick Friend Pet Selection Grid Layout: Switch the friend selection layout to a multi-column grid that displays preset companions clearly side by side. (why: Improving visual clarity during pet selection helps reduce adoption step drop-off (71.9%).)
